value.rationale: The antipodal double-cap family is canonical in geodesy and Slepian localization. For a natural complete irreducible harmonic degree, the theorem solves exact best-mode selection and its symmetry-breaking transition at the intrinsic coordinate RMS 1/sqrt(d), including a sharp eigenspace-dimension jump and full conditioning constants. It is a structural parameter classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice, and does not claim a new general Slepian formulation.
